FAO56.citation: Allen, R.G., Pereira, L.S., Raes, D., Smith, M. (1998). Crop evapotranspiration - Guidelines for computing crop water requirements. FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56, Rome.
FAO56.license: FAO publication, free to read; cite. Coefficients are global published references.
FAO56.geographic_applicability: Global method; individual coefficients are generic and NOT calibrated for Rajshahi/Barind or Iowa

FAO56_EX18.citation: FAO-56 Chapter 4, Example 18: daily ET0 at Uccle (Brussels) on 6 July = 3.9 mm/day
FAO56_EX18.geographic_applicability: Used ONLY as a numerical verification baseline for the ET0 code

FAO56_ANNEX1_NV.citation: Typical soil water characteristics for different soil types (from FAO-56 Table 19), as reproduced in Table 1 of the FAO-56 Dual Crop Coefficient Method annex, Nevada Division of Water Resources.

FAO_IDP_RICE_WATER.citation: FAO Irrigation Water Management training manual no. 3 / irrigation water needs chapter: rice IN = ETc + SAT + PERC + WL - Pe; SAT 200 mm, PERC 4 (heavy clay) to 8 mm/day (sandy), WL 100 mm.
FAO_IDP_RICE_WATER.geographic_applicability: Generic paddy water-balance components; percolation in puddled Barind soils needs local measurement

WOCAT_AWD_BD.citation: WOCAT technology record 4671, Alternate wetting and drying (AWD) method in rice cultivation [Bangladesh] (cites Riaz et al. 2017).
WOCAT_AWD_BD.geographic_applicability: Bangladesh; reported 20-25% water saving is a field-trial claim, not a model output

KHAN_2026_CHICKPEA.citation: Khan, M.S.R., Uddin, M.Z., Moniruzzaman, M., Khatun, A., Oliver, M.M.H. (2026). Irrigation scheduling for improving yield and water productivity of chickpea variety BARI Chola-9. SAARC Journal of Agriculture 24(1): 271-286.
KHAN_2026_CHICKPEA.geographic_applicability: Gazipur and Godagari (Rajshahi) field trials 2018-19; silty clay loam, FC 28.5-29%. Pod development moisture reported as critical; depths in mm not reported in the text we could access

VANCE_2015.citation: Vance, W.H., Bell, R.W., Johansen, C. (2015). Optimum soil water content for chickpea emergence in heavy-textured soils of north-west Bangladesh. J. Agronomy & Crop Science 201(3):195-205. doi:10.1111/jac.12121
VANCE_2015.geographic_applicability: High Barind Tract, Godagari, Rajshahi: soil 48% sand/24% silt/28% clay. No field-capacity number was reported for this soil in the text we accessed, so it is NOT used as TAW

KHAN_2025_MUSTARD.citation: Khan, M.A.H., Akhtar, S., Hossain, M.A. (2025). Inclusion of short duration mustard increases productivity and profitability of rice based cropping pattern in north-eastern Bangladesh. Bangladesh J. Agril. Res. 50(4):353-363.
KHAN_2025_MUSTARD.geographic_applicability: North-eastern Bangladesh; BARI Sarisha-14 sowing-to-harvest 76-79 days (2 seasons)

ISLAM_2015_BARI.citation: Islam, M.N., Rahman, M.S., Alom, M.S., Akhteruzzaman, M. (2015). Performance of different crops productivity enhancement through adaptation of crop varieties at charland in Bangladesh. Bangladesh J. Agril. Res. 40(4):629-640.
ISLAM_2015_BARI.geographic_applicability: Kushtia charland, one 2012-13 trial: BARI Sarisha-14 84 d; BARI Masur-4/5/6 110-111 d

NASA_POWER.citation: NASA Prediction Of Worldwide Energy Resources (POWER), Agroclimatology daily. Meteorology from MERRA-2 (0.5 x 0.625 deg), solar from CERES SYN1deg / SRB (1 x 1 deg).
NASA_POWER.geographic_applicability: Gridded model/reanalysis estimate, not an in-field sensor, not a forecast. Consumed via EarthSync only.

NASA_SMAP.citation: SMAP Enhanced L3 Radiometer Global Daily 9 km EASE-Grid Soil Moisture (SPL3SMP_E), NSIDC.
NASA_SMAP.geographic_applicability: 9 km, top ~5 cm only. Used as context disagreement flag, never as root-zone depletion

FARMER_GROUND.citation: Farmer-entered events and field tests (irrigation, rainfall, soil moisture, soil test).
FARMER_GROUND.geographic_applicability: Specific farm; farmer-reported unless a verified measurement is flagged

AQUASENSE_ASSUMPTION.citation: Engineering assumption chosen by the AquaSense author; NOT a published coefficient. Must be replaced or confirmed by local evidence.
